Regulation Set M-C Details

Eligible Pokémon

Of the Pokémon available in Pokémon Champions, only the Pokémon displayed in Eligible Pokémon below are eligible to participate.​

You can use Mega Evolution only one time per battle.

Duplicate held items are not allowed.​
